title: Introduce transitive affordance anchors and compact release-seed generator
author: Maya Thompson
description:
Context: onboarding larger open models today produces noisy release notes and duplicate affordance hints when a model variant transitively derives from multiple base artifacts. This PR introduces two tightly related pieces: 1) a compact transitive "affordance anchor" annotation set that deduplicates and scopes affordance/compatibility hints across variant chains, and 2) a release-seed compactifier that synthesizes a terse release seed (changelog fragment) for use in the automated release-note generator and in the CLI onboarding flow.

Motivation: reduce churn in model registry release notes, make upgrade diffs easier to read for users and evaluators, and make the onboard pipeline resilient to long transitive dependency chains (e.g., forked checkpoints and small fine-tunes). This improves downstream evals and the redact/rollback pathways by keeping the seed minimal and provenance-aware.

What changed (high level): added an affordance anchor data model, an algorithm that collapses transitive affordances into canonical anchors with provenance pointers, a compactifier that turns a profile delta into a one-page release seed, and a small CLI flag (--compact-seed) that emits the compact seed during onboard. The compactifier also tags candidate drop-in replacements for quantized variants to help automated release-note templating.

Implementation notes: implementation is in three files: anchors/* contains the annotation model and serializer; compactifier/* contains the seed generator and deterministic sampling; onboard/cli adds the new flag and wiring into the upload flow. The compactifier uses a stable hash (xxh64 seed with repo salt) to ensure repeatable compact seeds across runs; a compatibility window prevents accidental aliasing across minor model versions. Affordance anchors keep a short provenance array (max 3 entries) to avoid large payloads while still giving human operators a path to the source.

Backward compatibility and migration: new annotations are optional. Existing model profiles are left untouched; the onboard CLI will emit compact seeds only when --compact-seed is passed or when the Linear ticket indicates a compact onboarding flow. For existing release automation, the release-note assembler will prefer compact seeds when present but falls back to the full delta. Migration script: scripts/migrators/affordance-backfill.sh (small, idempotent) is included to backfill anchors for models onboarded in the last 90 days.

Testing and validation: unit tests for anchor collapse and compactifier stability added (anchors_test.py, compactifier_test.py). Added a small sampling harness that compares full delta vs compact seed at 1000 random deltas to assert that >95% of user-visible affordances are preserved in the compact seed. CI: runs unit, lint, and lightweight integration with the onboard CLI; an optional e2e sampling run exists behind a CI toggle.

Rollout plan: feature gated behind registry feature-flag "compact-seed". Default rollout to alpha internal projects for one week, then to public staged projects. Monitor: release_note_size and seed_collision_rate metrics added to console (per-model).

Related work: this complements ENG-4217 (release-note templating refactor) and PM-214 (onboard UX condensed summaries).

review_comments: Asha: Can we guarantee the compactifier won't drop security-relevant affordances? Please ensure explicit allowlist for anything tagged 'exposes-PII' — author: added allowlist and tests.
Benji: hashing collision concerns for stable seed? suggest increasing seed-length or adding repo salt — author: switched to xxh64 with repo salt and added collision metrics.
Dalia: migration script should be idempotent and rate-limited for large registries — author: added rate-limit flag and dry-run mode to migrator.
discussion_summary: Reviewers requested safety allowlists, hashing stability, and safe migration controls. Author addressed all points in follow-up commits. Small last-minute tweak to reduce provenance array size for payload safety.
release_notes:
- Add: transitive affordance anchors to deduplicate variant affordances.
- Add: compact release-seed generator (CLI flag --compact-seed) to produce terse changelog fragments for automated releases.
- Tools: migrator script to backfill anchors for recent models.
- Metrics: release_note_size, seed_collision_rate (console dashboards)
